intro.h2: A Remodeling Team That Brings Ideas
paragraphs: FJ Remodeling does home remodeling in Balch Springs and the surrounding area, from bathrooms finished in large-format tile to backyard pool decks with pergolas and lattice privacy panels. Their Google profile holds a 5.0 rating from 17 reviews.

What stands out in the reviews is how Franco works with homeowners. Jose C. says Mr. Jara had many great ideas for their pool deck and that they love the finished product. N. E. calls the team thorough, kind and professional, and good at communicating and negotiating. That mix of design ideas and straight talk is the reason customers recommend Franco and his team.

services.h2: Home Remodeling Services in Balch Springs

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Full bathroom remodels with large-format porcelain tile, double vanities, new lighting and soaking tubs. The finished bathroom shown has a black double vanity with a white top, gold faucets, matching black mirrors and a corner tub with gray tile surround.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with black double vanity, gold faucets, black framed mirrors and a corner tub with gray tile

items.name: Tile showers
items.blurb: Walk-in showers built with large travertine-look slabs and a half wall, carried through to matching floor tile. The photo shows a shower mid-install, with the long veined panels already set and the glass and fixtures still to come.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with large travertine-look porcelain panels and a tiled half wall during installation

items.name: Pool decks and pergolas
items.blurb: Wood decks built around above-ground pools, with stairs, railings, lattice privacy panels and a pergola for shade. Jose C. says Mr. Jara was very professional, had many great ideas and that the family loves the finished pool deck.

image.alt: Wood pool deck with stairs, railing, lattice screen and pergola beside an above-ground pool at night

items.name: Kitchen and interior remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchen remodeling and interior updates are listed among their services. Interior jobs in their photos include exposed ceiling beams and new light fixtures. Ask about your kitchen or living space when you call, and Franco can talk through ideas and a price.

items.title: Ideas, not just labor
items.text: Jose C. says Mr. Jara had many great ideas for their pool deck. You get a contractor who helps shape the design, not one who only follows a drawing.

items.title: Thorough and kind
items.text: N. E. describes the team as thorough, kind and professional, and says they were very pleased with the result of their project.

items.title: Clear communication on price
items.text: The same reviewer says the team was good at communicating and negotiating, so scope and price were talked through openly before and during the work.

items.title: A 5.0 Google rating
items.text: FJ Remodeling holds a 5.0 rating from 17 Google reviews, and the homeowners who wrote reviews recommend Franco and his team by name.

about.text: FJ Remodeling is run by Franco, called Mr. Jara by one of his customers, together with his team. The company's Facebook page lists it in Balch Springs, Texas, and its yard signs carry the number 469-510-7775. The work ranges from indoor projects like bathrooms, tile showers and kitchens to outdoor builds such as pool decks and pergolas. Reviewers describe Franco as very professional, full of ideas and easy to talk to about price. His Google profile holds a 5.0 rating from 17 reviews.

image.alt: Wood pergola with lattice privacy panels over a pool deck beside an above-ground pool

steps.title: Call
steps.text: Call 469-510-7775 and describe the bathroom, kitchen or backyard project you have in mind, with photos if you have them.

steps.title: Ideas and price
steps.text: Franco looks at the space, shares ideas and talks through the price openly. Reviewers say the team is good at negotiating.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The team frames, tiles or builds the project, keeping you updated. Reviewers describe them as thorough and good at communicating.

steps.title: Walkthrough
steps.text: You walk through the finished space together and make sure you are happy with the result before the job is closed.

items.name: Jose C.
items.text: Mr. Jara did an amazing job on our pool deck. He is very professional and had many great ideas for us. We love the finish product and we are very happy with his work .

service_area.text: FJ Remodeling's Facebook page lists the business in Balch Springs, Texas, and the phone number on its yard signs is a local 469 number. The Google profile does not show an address or service area yet, so if you live nearby and are not sure whether your home is in range, call 469-510-7775 and ask Franco directly before you plan the project.

items.q: What kind of projects do you take on?
items.a: Bathroom remodeling, tile showers, kitchen remodeling, interior updates, and outdoor builds such as pool decks and pergolas. The photos on their Google profile include a finished bathroom with a double vanity and corner tub, a large-format tile shower and a wraparound pool deck. Call to describe your project.

items.q: Can you help with design ideas?
items.a: Yes. One homeowner says Mr. Jara had many great ideas for their pool deck and they love the finished product. If you are not sure what you want yet, share photos of the space and anything you like, and Franco can suggest options before you settle on a price.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Call 469-510-7775, the number on the FJ Remodeling yard signs, and describe the work. Franco will look at the space and talk through scope and cost. A reviewer says the team was good at communicating and negotiating, so ask any questions you have about the price up front.

items.q: Do you build decks around above-ground pools?
items.a: Yes. Several photos show a wood deck built around an above-ground pool, with stairs, railings, lattice privacy panels and a pergola for shade. The framing photos show the deck built on new posts and joists around the pool wall before the boards go on.

The Google profile lists FJ Remodeling as open 24 hours, every day. In practice, calling 469-510-7775 during the day is the best way to reach Franco. If he is on a job, leave your name, address and a short note about the project so he can call you back.

final_cta.text: Call Franco about your bathroom, kitchen or pool deck in Balch Springs and nearby.
